# ChametApps.com

> Independent, source-checked guidance for Chamet agency and host onboarding in India. Not the official Chamet website. The site publishes an agency referral registration route and explains registration, the agency dashboard, Beans and MetWallet withdrawals in plain English.

Last reviewed: 27 November 2026

## What this site is

- An independent guidance site for adults (18+) considering a Chamet host account or agency account.
- Written for readers in India, with English and Hindi support through WhatsApp.
- Registration links are agency referral links with company ID 87692. Joining an agency is optional.
- The site does not process payments, hold funds, verify identities or operate a wallet.
- No income, approval, exchange rate or payment time is guaranteed.

## Core guides

- [Chamet agency registration](https://chametapps.com/chamet-agency-registration/): six-step agency account creation, phone verification, password setup, profile and invitation links.
- [Chamet host registration](https://chametapps.com/chamet-host-registration/): 14-step host sign-up, email verification, face check and profile setup.
- [Agency login and dashboard](https://chametapps.com/chamet-agency-login/): portal sign-in, password recovery, invite links, host and agent reports, MetWallet binding.
- [Withdrawal overview](https://chametapps.com/chamet-withdrawal/): the three withdrawal stages and who controls each one.
- [Host withdrawal](https://chametapps.com/chamet-host-withdrawal/): My Earning, conditions, MetWallet binding and request confirmation.
- [Agency withdrawal](https://chametapps.com/chamet-agency-withdrawal/): linking MetWallet from My Profile and when commission becomes payable.
- [MetWallet cash out](https://chametapps.com/metwallet-withdrawal/): verification, payout method, payment password and transfer tracking.
- [App download](https://chametapps.com/chamet-app-download/): official install routes for Android and iPhone, and why modified APKs are risky.
- [Help by stage](https://chametapps.com/chamet-help/): registration, login and payment troubleshooting with anchors.
- [Chamet agency in India](https://chametapps.com/chamet-agency-india/): what "agency near me" means for an online-first service, rupee payouts and how to verify a team.

## Key facts used on this site

- Chamet's published host earnings page states 10,000 Beans = US$1 and a US$10 minimum for an eligible host balance to MetWallet.
- Host and agency income is activity-based; the site does not present a salary or a guaranteed monthly figure.
- The site does not publish a fixed USD-to-INR rate; the MetWallet cash-out quote governs each conversion.
- Agency commission is a percentage applied to an eligible base under the platform's rules, not a salary.
- Screenshots are annotated examples; interface labels and conditions can differ by app version and account.
- Banner portraits are generated illustrations, not staff, hosts or testimonials.

## Trust and limits

- The site is not operated by Chamet and cannot verify or reinstate accounts.
- "Certified Chamet agency" appears as a description provided by the site owner; no certificate number or official badge is displayed.
- Identity verification and payment decisions belong to Chamet, MetWallet and the relevant payment providers.
- The site never asks for passwords, OTPs or payment passwords.
